[[File:Seismic_charge.jpg|thumb|right|350px|[[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'''s]] minelayer deploying a seismic charge]]
A '''minelayer''', or '''mine launcher''', was a weapon system mounted on a vehicle and used to lay mines. When fitted on [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] (often ships dedicated to this role and dubbed [[Minelayer (starship type)|minelayers]]), such systems deployed [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]].

==Description==
The minelayer was used to launch or drop a mine which could later be armed via a timer or remote control. Under certain pre-defined circumstances, often the proximity of an enemy, the mine would then automatically detonate, with the minelaying craft at a safe distance.
